# Thee Olympia Gridiron Co. — keeper rules

Public host for the league's keeper rules and 2025 rosters, served by GitHub Pages.

**This repo holds one generated file and nothing else.** It contains no league data, no
credentials, and no personal information — only fantasy team names and NFL players.

The source, the data, and the generator live in the private `olympia-gridiron` repo. Edit the copy
there (`content/keeper-sheets.md`), rebuild, and run `scripts/deploy_site.sh` to update this page.
